Our Services

Personal Vedic guidance, not a marketplace of ads

Numerology

Naam, janm tithi aur ank-yog dekhkar aapke liye shubh ank aur timing samjhai jaati hai.

Hand Reading

Hast rekha se swabhav, career sanket aur jeevan ke muddon par ek saaf reading di jaati hai.

Kundli (By DOB)

Date, time aur place of birth se janmkundli banakar dasha, yog aur savdhaniyan batayi jaati hain.

Career Problem

Naukri rukna, interview, promotion ya galat field ka ehsaas ho to kundli se direction milti hai.

Astrology for Business

Vyapar shuru karna, partner chunna ya loss ke samay ke liye muhurat aur upay poochhe jaate hain.

Love Problem

Prem sambandh, dooriyan aur misunderstanding par Vedic drishtikon se salah di jaati hai.

Family Problems

Ghar ke taalmela, vastu sanket aur parivarik tanav ko shant karne ke upay bataye jaate hain.

Kundli Matching

Guna milan, manglik dosh aur vivah yog dekhkar shaadi se pehle spasht report milti hai.
